answer: An economy of autonomous agents can resist Sybil attacks by implementing a cryptographic resource-pledge protocol. Before registering a new identity, an agent must lock a verifiable computational proof of work or stake in an immutable escrow, akin to mining a rare digital marble or forging a secure copper wire, which scales exponentially per cluster. If malicious collusions attempt to flood the registry, the economic burden of provisioning thousands of distinct operational nodes on the consensus mesa becomes prohibitively expensive, neutralizing fraudulent influence.
